readings.decision_rule_6_1: Read first on update wall-clock and batch-1 latency, with counted multiply-adds as the secondary reading (D-88). A cell without a timing key (profile det) is skipped in a wall-clock mean, never averaged as zero; the report says how many seeds each column rests on.
readings.pool_of_the_predictions: A2 is the pool of the predictions, A1 is printed beside it (D-88). The equal-memory and compute-matched baselines are sized to both reference pools (D-88).
readings.rule_6_2_growth: The whole-run wall-clock of the gap-growth pair cell against its probe pair cell is pooled over the timed seeds; accuracy is read on all ten seeds.
readings.M1-7: Read with A2 as the pool and the primary reading of rule 6.1, per bed, on report-seed means.
readings.M1-8: Fitted on the A2 record with the most regimes on bed B1, memory taken after the first visit of each regime; the slope is compared with one expert's bytes.
readings.acceptance: Adoption thresholds of 6.2 stay as drafted (D-88). No single-use confirmatory run in M1; a gain seen on development seeds is re-checked on report seeds (F-101).

run_plan.arms: A1,A1q,A2,A3,A4,A5a,A5b,A6,A7,A7all,A8,A3-2,A4-2,A7-2 and the held-default pair cells H

timed.how: one process at a time on logical processors 0 and 2, two threads, the machine otherwise idle

deterministic.how: four workers of two threads on logical processors 0,2 / 4,6 / 8,10 / 1,3, never at the same time as the timed pass

run_plan.extension_rule: none: five timed seeds from the start (option A of Q-82)
known_limits: wall-clock verdicts rest on the five timed seeds, accuracy and counted multiply-adds on all ten
the GPU repeat of the wide networks (D-89) is not built; every cell runs on the CPU
A6 and A8 sit at the edge of their tuning grids on B1 and the B3 schedules; A3 sits at its raised edge (16384) on B1; the report prints the at_edge notes
tuning used development seeds 800-804 only; B1 operating points were tuned at N = 30 and reused at N = 10 and N = 100
